mechanism: NSAIDs reduce renal blood flow and inhibit prostaglandin-mediated vasodilation, impairing the antihypertensive efficacy of ACE inhibitors and increasing risk of acute kidney injury and hyperkalemia.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and blood pressure closely; consider alternative analgesic or ensure adequate hydration and dose optimization; avoid concurrent use if possible, particularly in elderly or those with baseline renal impairment.
